Subject: Kickoff coordination: week-zero attendee lanes, access & hosting links

Hi Elena —

Congrats again on selecting Redwood for inference. Before we lock the kickoff calendar, quick proposal to keep the session sharp and ensure the right folks join:

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Option A: Thu 2028-07-19 09:00–10:30 PT
- Option B: Fri 2028-07-20 13:00–14:30 PT

Agenda (45–60 min core + 30 min optional deep dives):
1) Intros & success criteria (10 min)
2) Deployment choices & networking checklist (15 min)
3) Data flow & security Qs (10 min)
4) Ops/roles, runbook walkthrough (15 min)
5) Next steps & action owners (10 min)

To help us prepare, can you confirm by EOD:
- Preferred window (A/B or propose another)
- Who will attend from HumanaTech (names + roles) for: Engineering, Security, Procurement, and Product
- Any special compliance or access constraints (e.g., IP allowlists, air-gapped environments)

Internal note: Marissa (CS lead) and Ben (Ops) are on this thread to pick owners for runbook items and bridge staffing.

Links for reference — we’ll send final calendar invite once attendees are confirmed:
- Draft kickoff runbook: attachment (kickoff-runbook-v1.pdf)
- Sandbox/hosted join link (will be the meeting link once scheduled): https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210

Thanks — Vivek
